title: Automation Protocol for Plasmid DNA Extraction from E. coli
author: Nina Alperovich
materials: Use the filter press to push the lysate solutions through the filter plate into a new 96-well deep well plate (Eppendorf, 951033588) at 20 psi for 240 s followed by 65 psi for 60 s.

Transfer the cleared lysate solutions to a 96-well glass fiber binding plate (Nunc, 278010) and use the filter press to push the solutions through the binding plate at 40 psi for 60 s. 24 samples at a time with the 96-channel head

steps.title: Pellet cell cultures
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 96‑well deep‑well plate containing ~1.8 mL combined E. coli culture per well at 3878 g (4500 rpm) for 10 min at 23 °C to form cell pellets.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Using an 8‑channel pipetting head, aspirate and discard the supernatant from each well, taking care not to disturb the cell pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend pellets in P1
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Resuspension Buffer (P1) to each pellet and mix 10 times by repeated aspiration and dispense with the 8‑channel head (8 samples at a time).

steps.title: Transfer to shaker plate
steps.instruction: Move the resuspended cell samples to a new 96‑well plate (Abgene, AB‑1127) placed on an automated microplate shaker, handling 8 samples at a time with the 8‑channel head.

steps.title: Add Lysate Buffer and mix
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL Lysate Buffer (P2) to each well and shake the plate at 90 rpm for 2 min (24 samples at a time with the 96‑channel head).

steps.title: Add Neutralization Buffer and mix
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL cold (4 °C) Neutralization Buffer (N3, Qiagen, 19064) to each well and shake at 90 rpm for 2 min (24 samples at a time with the 96‑channel head).

steps.title: Mix lysate and transfer to filter plate
steps.instruction: Using wide‑bore tips (3.2 mm diameter), gently mix each lysate by 3 cycles of aspiration and dispensing, then transfer the lysate to a 96‑well filter plate (Agilent, 201702‑100) and let it settle for 2 min (24 samples at a time with the 96‑channel head).

steps.title: Add Binding Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL Binding Buffer (PB, Qiagen, 19066) to each well of the filter plate (24 samples at a time with the 96‑channel head).

steps.title: Add Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL Wash Buffer (PE) to each well (24 samples at a time with the 96‑channel head).

steps.title: Filter press – initial press
steps.instruction: Place the filter plate in the filter press and push buffer through the binding plate at 40 psi for 60 s.

steps.title: Filter press – drying step
steps.instruction: Increase the filter press pressure to 65 psi and maintain for 420 s to dry the binding plate.

steps.title: Add pre‑warmed water
steps.instruction: Add 130 µL nuclease‑free water (Thermo Scientific, AM9938) warmed to 60 °C to each well using jet dispense with an 8‑channel head (8 samples at a time) directly onto the binding plate filters.

steps.title: Final elution – low pressure
steps.instruction: Using the filter press, push the water through the binding plate at 40 psi for 60 s.

steps.title: Final elution – high pressure
steps.instruction: Elute DNA into a 96‑well low‑binding elution plate (Eppendorf, 30603303) by applying 65 psi for 7 min with the filter press.

steps.title: Transfer stack to biosafety cabinet
steps.instruction: Carefully move the stacked elution plate, binding plate, and lid to a biosafety cabinet (or clean bench), hold the stack firmly against the interior surface, and gently remove the sealing tape.

steps.title: Assemble plates for centrifugation
steps.instruction: Place the binding plate on top of the elution plate, then put the lid on the binding plate, keeping the three components together with tape.

steps.title: Centrifuge stacked plates
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the stacked plates at 1000 rpm for 3 min, using an empty stack of similar labware for balance.

steps.title: Remove binding plate
steps.instruction: Detach the binding plate from the elution plate and either store it for reuse or discard it as waste.

steps.title: Seal and store elution plate
steps.instruction: Seal the elution plate with a clear adhesive seal (Fisherbrand 8408240) and store at 4 °C until needed for BarSeq library preparation.

steps.title: Deliver elution plate to user
steps.instruction: Place a lid on the sealed elution plate and move it to the designated pickup location for the user.
